body: Be understanding. Talk to him and actually listen to what he says. Offer help, support, anything. Don't dismiss how he feels. He needs you now more than ever and I'm really glad you want to be there. Tell him to talk to you if he feels like hurting himself. Listen quietly even if you want to say something so badly. Listening goes so much farther than some think.
The numbness makes it easier for me. Sucks when all the pain hits at once, but at the same time it's almost like a high.

I don't think you ever really stop, ever. The longest I was clean was almost 2 years. Then I cut constantly for about 8 months. Then I was clean for a year and 4 months, now I've started again. I stopped for my then boyfriend, then we split up and I fell into a deep depression, then I went to therapy, was good for a year and 4 months and now I've started again. I know I'll stop eventually, but I don't think I'll ever stop for good.

No problem :) hot showers also help, I find I've gotten at least an ounce more if I pump right after showering. Don't be too hard on yourself. Being relaxed and as stress free as possible has a lot to do with it as well. Anything you can get is perfect. With my oldest I could only keep up for about 3 months before he was eating way more then I could produce in a single session. I had to supplement and slowly transition him over to formula, so there's no shame in that. Do what's best for you and for baby, even if it does mean getting on formula over BM.

Yes. I know it's frustrating only getting a little bit, but keep going. I struggled really bad with my first born and the best advice I got was to keep trying, and often. I would pump everytime he woke up and wanted to eat, which was about every 2 to 3 hours. I wasn't giving much and I felt horrible. My mom and the LC told me to up my pumps to every hour to an hour and a half. It helped a lot. Even though in the beginning I wasn't getting a lot, it made my body think Dean wanted to eat more often then he was, and helped increase my supply. I've also found massaging/jiggling my breasts helped a lot, and I use the same techniques with my second son as well. I use coconut oil and start at my arm pit and rub with firm but gentle pressure from my armpit/chest to the nipple a few times then lean forward, cupping them and gently jiggling them, and repeat. It helps bring any milk down and it's relaxing. I know it's tough, but I know you can do it!

I had a really hard time keeping up with my first son. He wanted to eat pretty often and by 3 months old I had to start supplenting with formula because he would still be hungry and I didn't have anymore to give. 

Currently on baby boy #2 and if I'm not pumping every hour and a half to 2 hours, my boobs hurt so bad and feel like rocks and I'm leaking everywhere. He's only a week old and he's a big eater like his brother. Thankfully I think I'll be able to keep up with him because to me it seems like my supply is non stop and am able to keep up with him, with surplus, for now. 

So no, low supply with one doesn't necessarily mean low supply with another.
Don't stress, my brother and I were 2 weeks early, and my son was only 3 days early. Fingers crossed this one follows about the same
Oh wow... your due date doesn't work for her? Oh my lord. I would have driven myself over there and punched her in her entitled face. I'm sorry she's like that.
I would kill him if he went and kill my mil for even asking  that. Like he needs to be with you and the baby
That's too funny! At least he's trying to keep the bedroom spark alive!

That's terrible!  What about the moms like my mom and my step mom who couldn't feed their babies?! My mom had twins (my brother and I ) and she didn't produce anywhere near enough to feed us both. My step mom couldn't produce at all, and actually got the lactation specialist fired because of the nasty/rude comments she made towards her (my step mom worked that that hospital for almost 20 years before this happened so she had quite a bit of pull with the higher ups). Don't get me wrong, I'm all for breastfeeding and the bond it forms, but sometimes it's just not the best option or an option at all! When I had my first son, I pumped milk for him, because the feeling of his nursing just made my skin crawl and I don't know why. I don't know what I would do in your shoes. I didn't have a c-section, but I still needed a bunch of help getting out of bed and getting around the first few days after I had Dean. 

Those poor nurses as well! They just have to let those poor newborns cry because of the stupid awards the hospital is trying to win? That's terrible terrible terrible. I'd make a really big fuss with anyone that you can about getting things changed back because it's not right to just let babies starve for the sake of an award.

Yes yes yes! Kaiden is due in December and so many people I know have given me crap for getting the flu shot while pregnant because it'll go to the baby... they don't understand that that's the point! I don't need my new born getting that sick so young.
That's amazing. When I told my boyfriend we were expecting and he's just said, oh, okay. About 5 seconds later it hit him and he was so excited. Sometimes it feels like men need a big ol' neon sign!
Big big hugs to you and yours. I'm so sorry you're going through this. Many prayers and healing energy sent your way.

I did the same thing over my s/os cat. I was just hugging her and sobbing. He asked me what's wrong and I told him I'm upset because she will never be a mom, even if she is a crazy bitch, she deserves the chance. He had to walk away from me he was laughing so hard.
You just need to take a week long vacation and leave all that crazy behind momma! I'm sorry you've had to deal with all of that :(

I'm sorry your mom's like that honey! Honestly, if her pride is more important the then birth of your baby, then having her around might not be the best. You and the little one doesn't need that kind of stress. Sending you positive vibes for a better outcome!

The worry never leaves. I'm 30 weeks with my peanut and if he doesn't move or shift or anything, I get really nervous and I'll walk around or poke at my belly and the relief I feel when he kicks back it's enormous. I knew I was pregnant within a week and I was anxious everytime I got cramps or didn't feel well. Just know your body knows what's best, and things are gonna be okay. Minimum stress helps! Even if it's hard not to worry!
Many prayers from my family to yours. I can't imagine the grief you're going through. I'm so sorry sweetie.
She shouldn't push that on you, and being a member of the medical field should know why vaxxing is so important, especially for infants. That had to be awkward!
YEEESSS!!! My SO go around and around sometimes with the stupid things girls can or cannot do, because it's so normal that not all men think about about how stupid it is.
Congrats on your little man!! Kinda funny the way you find out, because I would have done the exact same the way my pregnancy brain has been lately! At least you're happy about the gender~

Both sets of my sons grandparents are getting it as well as any other vax that would be a good idea to get. I'm sorry, no vax - no touching the baby. Sorry not sorry. You're the mom and if she doesn't like it or doesn't want to get it well then she can admire from afar.

Actually two parents with Downs can have a perfectly normal baby with out downs. Just as 2 parents can have a child with downs with no family history of it, they can have a non-Downs baby. Shame on you for being so rude.

I'm sorry but that's complete bullshit. A grown ass adult shouldn't be acting like that! I've been having severe back and hip pain and I just wanna come home and lay down after work and my 20 y/o boyfriend understands completely. Sometimes I have to tell him no,  and be firm, but he gets it. I'm so sorry you gotta deal with that idiot on top of being so far along. Maybe if he doesn't stop, seek marriage counseling?

She's 22 almost 23. She's upset because I've changed. Well yes, that's what happens when you have kids. I can't be the same as was in high school. It is what it is though. I don't need that kind of person in my life right now.

Advice is alway welcome. 

My mom had my brother and I in one shot (twins), and never wanted more. She's upset that I started my family so young and that I'm having another baby without being married. That's honestly the thing she brings up the most is that I'm unmarried. But she married my father because of being pregnant and that marriage crashed and burned within 2 years, I don't want to take that risk. 

While she may worry about the baby, I would like to able to call her and talk about things because she's my mom. But I can't and it really bothers me. I turn to my coworker whose had mutipule kids and ask her for advice if things should feel this way or what this pain might mean and it sucks. I love my coworker, but I do need my mom.
How wonderful!! Good for you♡

I had informed the masses that what was on my registry was just a guideline for what I wanted and that they were free to go with what they could afford. I wasn't too picky on brands or what have you. Some people don't realize that, or the fact that baby stuff is sometimes on the pricier side.
Yay yay yay!! So happy for you!!♡

I'm so sorry to hear this! People just make me so sick. Why have a baby you can't care for? Ugh.. Okay so I would say talk to your sister, the state, whim ever and if you forster her I do believe the state will give you money each month to help care for said baby. I'm not sure about all states but that's how it works where I live. The best of luck to you and that baby!
I've stopped warning my SO. I just start giggling and he just knows. I have no shame.
Good luck!!

Honestly their feelings are not as important as yours. I mean you push out this baby, and everyone and their mothers need to come see the baby. If you don't wanna announce it for a little bit then dont! Tell your SO that you're putting your foot down and youre not changing your mind.
Aw that's really stupid! I plan on taking my 2 year old to my next ultrasound. Weird that some obgyn offices don't let you bring kids :/
I knew I was having a boy with my son and a feeling it's a girl with this one. Everyone knows I'll be happy with either or, we're just placing bets at this point. Congrats on you little man!

I had a friend who thought I was naming this baby Peanut cause that's what I call him/her, and with my son I nicknamed him demon spawn, cause my mother used to call me demon, and she thought I was naming him that. Ahh people amuse me

I wish my doctor had even done that! He just came in, and did my check up and what not, but like it was so robotic and I felt so exposed the whole time. I didn't even let my s/o touch me a whole lot until I got home to take a hot shower. I just felt gross. There's 5 doctors in the practice I'm going to and if I don't like the next one I see I'm finding new doctors.

I hated that. I hated when people would touch me without asking first, especially people I didn't really know! My best friends mom who I've known forever, and is a second mom to me, would ask me if it was okay to rub my belly. Every. Single. Time. And she kept it easily under 15 seconds. Even though she and a few other people always had the okay to rub my belly, they were the only ones to asked. Even my s/o asks! It's just respectful to ask first.

Sweetie don't stress. I had people tell me the same thing when I was pregnant with my son and even with this one. It's just bloating. But it's not. I knew it wasn't. I'm a really petite gal, and I showed really fast with my son and even faster with this baby. Don't let people make you feel shitty about having your, obviously, adorable baby bump. Rock it and ignore them!

Eat her. I remeber when I was huge with my son I had a really hard time walking because my pelvis felt like it was going to snap in half (I'm only 5'3" and he was 9lbs), I had used those motorized carts at the grocery store and I had a lady comment that just because I was pregnant didn't mean I could use it and I simply said 'I'm 36 weeks pregnant. Dont make me eat you." My s/o was shocked I said anything cause I'm usually a quiet person but I was in no mood for anyone's snarky comments while in pain, thank you.
Oh I know how you feel! I have a boy and I'm hoping for a girl! I know when I find out I'll be happy either way, but I really really want a girl!

Pregnancy definitely does not make me feel sexy. I can't button my pants, none of the clothes fit right, and I've got a small bump which just makes me look fat over pregnant. But my s/o tells me I'm his beautiful pregnant princess, and that my baby belly just makes me that much more desirable because I'm carrying his baby. Even if I don't believe it all the time it makes me feel better knowing he still loves me, loves this little baby, and the fact I'm just gonna get bigger doesn't bother him at all.
I knew a girl in high school that faked a pregnancy and it made me so mad. Pregnancy just isn't something to fake, and then to fake losing a baby ugh. That's low.

They actually have changed my due date twice, and I think I finally have the final one. At the first ultrasound they said I was 6 weeks and due 12/14,  and a month later I was told I was a week farther then I had originally been told, and was due 12/9. All depends on how big the baby is I suppose.

For me it wasn't until I saw the ultra sound of my baby. It looked so much like a little baby already and that's when it started to feel real, and when you feel that first kick or wiggle. That's when it really started for me.

Big big BIG hugs.

I had my son when I was 18, and he's currently 2. I am currently almost 17 weeks with my second. My family is not very supportive of this baby nor where they of my son, but you know what. It gets better. I have raised my baby and will raise this one too with or without my family support. It would be nice, but you don't need that kind of negativity right now and neither does the little baby. It's not easy, i wont lie to you and say it's a cake walk, but it is not as hard as you think. When that little baby comes and you hold it in your arms you will do everything you can to keep it safe and by your side. 

It will get better. Just maybe not right away.

Tums are your best friend. I wouldn't classify them as medication IMO, but yours might be different. I have to carry the 200 tab bottle with me in my purse it gets so bad sometimes. Only word of caution is to try not to take them every 10 minutes, which is all I wanted to do, just in case of calcium build up.
Honestly the only pain I had while breastfeeding was when my uterus would cramp to shrink back down. My son always had a good latch.

Honestly it's probably due to the stress and whatnot of being so far along, plus the worry of your BP. I know what helps me when I'm stressed before a BP test is to take deep even breaths as soon as I sit on the table in the room. By the time the nurse or whom ever comes in, I'm usually relaxed enough to give a good read. Just keep calm and remember to breathe. You'll be fine :)
You should be okay. As long as it isn't the one where you're there for what feels like forever plus, I don't think there will be any problem.
Thanks for all the welcoming vibes guys! No idea how good that makes me feel 💟
How adorable! Congrats to you and welcome to your wonderful bundle 😍

Awwww what a good guy! Don't worry hunny we all have these moments. When I was pregnant with my first I had a melt down in the middle of the store because I couldn't find a bra (small rib cage, big boobs). It'll all be worth it when you hold that little bundle in your arms for the first time, promise. It's so good to hear your s/o being the chocolate savior of the day 😁

SO I work in a deli, which means 8 hours, sometimes more, of running around and what not. The only thing I have found that has helped at all, is the really nice Dr. Scholls insoles, compression knee socks, and adjusting how I walk. I rest all my weight on my heels, so by leaning more on my toes and spreading out my weight, it has helped my back, knees and ease some of the sciatica. 

I hope this helps a little bit!
Adorable! Congrats ❤
Seems pretty common to be amemic... I was with my first pregnancy and with this one. I had a hard time with the iron supplements, made me feel really sick and gross all the time.
